name: Algebraic Spin Glass Mapping
description: Replaces the graph-theoretic independent set condition with an algebraic stability constraint S_u + S_v <= 0 over variables S_i in {-1, 1}. This prevents models from triggering on keywords like "demolished" or "supporting", forcing them to mathematically deduce that two interacting variables cannot both be 1, which is exactly isomorphic to the independent set problem.
